svg.title: Mediation effects can have an identified sign while their magnitude remains unknown
svg.desc: All 316 arrowhead mediation prompts leave effect magnitudes unidentified. Of these, 226 bounds have one strict sign and support a binary answer under the stated model and target convention. Ninety allow opposite signs: 41 natural-direct and 49 natural-indirect questions. Each of the 316 plotted dots is one prompt. Claims depend on binary structural causal models, independent disturbances, exact displayed probabilities, and the specified pure natural estimand.
svg.text: Unknown size does not always mean unknown sign
All 316 prompts leave the exact effect magnitude unidentified.
Each dot is one audited prompt.

text.tspan: Every compatible world supports the same
yes/no direction under the stated target.
More than one answer fits the supplied data.

svg.text: The result is conditional on binary causal models, independent disturbances, and the chosen effect.
An unclear choice between pure and total natural effects can change the question itself.
